label: Hessian Conjecture · Claude Fable 5
title: A five-variable counterexample follows the Jacobian breakthrough
content: A new preprint derives an exact integer-polynomial counterexample to the Hessian conjecture from the Alpöge–Fable construction, with all defining identities checked in exact rational arithmetic.
titleZh: 雅可比突破催生五变量黑塞猜想反例
contentZh: 一篇新预印本从 Alpöge–Fable 构造导出整数系数的黑塞猜想反例，并以精确有理数运算核验全部恒等式。
statusLabelZh: 精确运算核验的预印本

label: Dinitz–Garg–Goemans Conjecture · GPT-5.6 Pro
title: A finite unsplittable-flow counterexample awaits specialist review
content: A released construction separates fractional cost 58 from every admissible unsplittable solution of cost at least 60. The finite certificate is checkable, but no stable scholarly manuscript or independent specialist review is yet available.
titleZh: 有限不可分流反例等待领域专家复核
contentZh: 公开构造把分数流成本 58 与所有成本至少为 60 的可行不可分流解分开。有限证书可以检查，但目前仍缺少稳定论文与独立领域评审。

label: Černý Conjecture · Codex with GPT-5.6 Sol
title: The one-cluster case receives an AI-assisted proof
content: A preprint proves the Černý bound for synchronizing one-cluster automata and a sharper parameterized result. The author states that the proof arose through interaction with Codex and was then verified by the author.
labelZh: Černý 猜想 · Codex with GPT-5.6 Sol
titleZh: 单簇自动机情形获得 AI 辅助证明
contentZh: 预印本证明同步单簇自动机满足 Černý 界，并给出更精细的参数化结果；作者说明证明由 Codex 交互产生并经本人核验。

label: Chernoff Density Conjecture · GPT-5.6 Sol
title: A 2014 strong log-concavity conjecture is proved
content: A statistical-theory note proves that Chernoff’s density is strongly log-concave and reports that GPT-5.6 Sol generated the proof in its entirety. The result is public as a research preprint.
labelZh: Chernoff 密度猜想 · GPT-5.6 Sol
titleZh: 2014 年提出的强对数凹猜想获证
contentZh: 一篇统计理论预印本证明 Chernoff 密度具有强对数凹性，并披露全部证明由 GPT-5.6 Sol 生成。

label: Jacobian Conjecture · Claude Fable 5
title: An explicit counterexample appears in complex dimension three
content: Levent Alpöge released a degree-seven polynomial map with constant Jacobian −2 and three distinct inputs sharing one image. Exact-arithmetic and independent Lean checks now make the finite certificate directly auditable.
titleZh: 三维复空间出现显式反例
contentZh: Levent Alpöge 公布一个七次多项式映射，其雅可比行列式恒为 −2，且三个不同输入具有同一像；精确运算与独立 Lean 核验使该有限证书可直接审计。

label: Cycle Double Cover Conjecture · GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra
title: Independent expositions clarify an AI-generated proof
content: After OpenAI released a concise proof, graph theorists published detailed expositions of the reduction and linear-algebra argument. The theorem says every bridgeless graph has a cycle double cover.
labelZh: 圈双覆盖猜想 · GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra
titleZh: 独立数学阐释厘清 AI 生成的证明
contentZh: OpenAI 发布简洁证明后，图论研究者给出详细阐释，解释其中的归约与线性代数论证；定理断言每个无桥图都有圈双覆盖。

label: Derivative-Free Optimization Problem · GPT-5.6 Sol Pro
title: A 30-year oracle-complexity gap closes up to logarithmic factors
content: A 148-minute AI-assisted session produced the central lower-bound argument for derivative-free convex optimization. The author checked it and supplied a Lean 4 formalization; the preprint remains unreviewed.
labelZh: 无导数优化问题 · GPT-5.6 Sol Pro
titleZh: 三十年查询复杂度缺口在对数因子内闭合
contentZh: 一次 148 分钟的 AI 辅助会话产出无导数凸优化下界的核心论证；作者完成核验与 Lean 4 形式化，但预印本尚未经同行评审。
statusLabelZh: 已形式化 · 未同行评审

label: Sabidussi Compatibility Conjecture · GPT-5.6 Sol
title: A graph-decomposition conjecture is proved and formalized in Lean
content: The proof partitions the edges of an even multigraph into compatible circuits and strengthens the statement to a four-colouring theorem. A public Lean 4 formalization accompanies the preprint.
labelZh: Sabidussi 相容性猜想 · GPT-5.6 Sol
titleZh: 图分解猜想获证并完成 Lean 形式化
contentZh: 证明把偶度多重图的边分解为相容回路，并强化为四色定理；预印本附有公开的 Lean 4 形式化。

label: Benjamini–Hochberg FDR Conjecture · GPT-5.6 Pro
title: Interval arithmetic certifies failure under correlated tests
content: A factor-model construction proves that the procedure can exceed its nominal false-discovery rate for correlated two-sided Gaussian tests. The paper says GPT-5.6 Pro obtained the proof and the author carefully checked it.
labelZh: Benjamini–Hochberg FDR 猜想 · GPT-5.6 Pro
titleZh: 区间算术证实相关检验下的失效
contentZh: 一个因子模型构造证明双侧高斯检验相关时，程序可能超过标称错误发现率；论文称证明由 GPT-5.6 Pro 获得并经作者仔细核验。

label: Erdős–Szemerédi Sum–Product Conjecture · GPT-5.5 Pro
title: Seven autonomous runs reproduce a disproof over the reals
content: A three-stage agent generated correct proofs in seven of eight trials, including constructions unlike the public human proof. The author independently verified every included proof and released the full traces.
labelZh: Erdős–Szemerédi 和积猜想 · GPT-5.5 Pro
titleZh: 七次自主运行重现实数域上的反驳
contentZh: 三阶段智能体在八次运行中七次生成正确证明，其中包括不同于公开人类证明的构造；作者独立核验全部收录证明并公开完整轨迹。

label: Jamming Exponent Identity · Claude Sonnet 4.6 + Opus 4.7
title: AI assistance helps close a long-standing physics derivation
content: Giorgio Parisi and Francesco Zamponi report a proof of an identity between critical exponents of jamming, with Claude used to explore and refine the argument before the authors verified the final derivation.
labelZh: 阻塞临界指数恒等式 · Claude Sonnet 4.6 + Opus 4.7
titleZh: AI 辅助完成长期悬而未决的物理推导
contentZh: Giorgio Parisi 与 Francesco Zamponi 给出阻塞临界指数恒等式的证明；Claude 用于探索和完善论证，最终推导由作者核验。

label: Erdős + OEIS Problems · AlphaProof Nexus
title: Formal proof search settles dozens of open entries
content: The AlphaProof Nexus study reports machine-checked Lean proofs for nine of 353 open Erdős problems and 44 of 492 open OEIS problems, pairing neural search with a kernel-verifiable endpoint.
labelZh: Erdős 与 OEIS 问题 · AlphaProof Nexus
titleZh: 形式化证明搜索解决数十个开放条目
contentZh: AlphaProof Nexus 研究报告了 353 个开放 Erdős 问题中的 9 个和 492 个开放 OEIS 问题中的 44 个 Lean 机器核验证明。

label: Planar Unit-Distance Conjecture · OpenAI Reasoning Model
title: A number-theoretic construction disproves a central geometry conjecture
content: An AI-generated construction refutes the conjectured near-linear upper bound for unit distances in the plane. Mathematicians checked the result and extracted the unexpected bridge from algebraic number theory.
labelZh: 平面单位距离猜想 · OpenAI 推理模型
titleZh: 数论构造推翻离散几何核心猜想
contentZh: AI 生成的构造反驳平面单位距离数近线性上界猜想；数学家完成核验，并揭示其与代数数论之间出人意料的联系。

label: Kissing Number Problem · AlphaEvolve
title: A 2026 impact review tracks a machine-found lower-bound improvement
content: DeepMind’s 2026 review revisits AlphaEvolve’s 11-dimensional construction, which raised the known kissing-number lower bound from 592 to 593. This is a record improvement, not a solution of the full problem.
titleZh: 2026 影响回顾追踪机器发现的下界改进
contentZh: DeepMind 的 2026 回顾重访 AlphaEvolve 的十一维构造：已知接吻数下界从 592 提升到 593。这是纪录改进，并非解决完整问题。

label: Directed-Cycle Decomposition Problem · Claude Opus 4.6
title: Claude finds the construction behind Knuth’s open problem
content: Claude discovered a general decomposition of a three-dimensional directed grid into Hamiltonian cycles after a guided computational search. Donald Knuth checked the construction and wrote the rigorous proof.
labelZh: 有向圈分解问题 · Claude Opus 4.6
titleZh: Claude 找到 Knuth 开放问题的通用构造
contentZh: Claude 在引导式计算搜索后发现三维有向网格的 Hamilton 圈通用分解；Donald Knuth 核验构造并写出严格证明。

label: Erdős Open Problems · Aletheia / Gemini Deep Think
title: Human–AI collaboration advances several open Erdős problems
content: Google DeepMind reports progress on four research problems, combining long-context mathematical reasoning with expert steering and verification. The cases illustrate collaboration rather than unattended theorem production.
labelZh: Erdős 开放问题 · Aletheia / Gemini Deep Think
titleZh: 人机协作推进多个 Erdős 开放问题
contentZh: Google DeepMind 报告了四个研究问题上的进展，把长上下文数学推理与专家引导、核验结合起来，体现协作而非无人值守的定理生产。
